lines.say: In the Torah, Abraham has two sons. Isaac's line: Judaism, then Christianity.
And Ishmael? Islamic tradition traces the Arabs back to him.
A.D. six-ten, Mecca. Muslims believe Muhammad starts receiving the Quran.
The Quran says Abraham and Ishmael raised the Kaaba.
Six twenty-two, he moves to Medina. Year one of the Islamic calendar.
Six thirty-two, he dies. Who leads now?
Most back Abu Bakr: Sunni. Some back Ali, his cousin: Shia. Split number two.
Six thirty-eight, Caliph Umar takes Jerusalem.
By six ninety-one, the Dome of the Rock stands there.
Ten ninety-nine, Crusaders take Jerusalem. Eighty-eight years later, Saladin takes it back.
Today: two point three billion Christians. Two billion Muslims. Fifteen million Jews.
Three faiths, one family. Part one is on my profile.
Which fact was new to you?
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
And every branch goes back to one name.

caption_en:
Three faiths call him father. Here is how the tree split. 🌳

In the Torah, Abraham has two sons: Isaac and Ishmael. Isaac's line becomes Judaism, then Christianity. Genesis 17:20: "As for Ishmael... I will make him into a great nation." Islamic tradition traces the Arabs back to Ishmael.
AD 610, Mecca: Muslims believe Muhammad starts receiving the Quran. The Quran (2:127) says Abraham and Ishmael raised the foundations of the Kaaba. (The Birmingham Quran folios are radiocarbon dated to AD 568 to 645.)
622: the move to Medina, year 1 of the Islamic calendar. 632: Muhammad dies. Who leads? Most back Abu Bakr (Sunni); some back Ali, his cousin and son-in-law (Shia). Today Shia are about 10 to 13% of Muslims (Pew, 2009).
638: Caliph Umar takes Jerusalem. 691/692: the Dome of the Rock stands on the Temple Mount.
1099: Crusaders take Jerusalem. 1187: Saladin takes it back.
Today (Pew Research Center 2025, 2020 data): 2.3 billion Christians (28.8%), 2.0 billion Muslims (25.6%), 14.8 million Jews (0.2%).

Three faiths, one family. Each tells the story its own way. Part 1 is on my profile.
Which fact was new to you? Tell me in the comments.

Quotes: Genesis 17:20 (NIV); Quran 2:127 (Sahih International).
Sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica; Pew Research Center (2009, 2025); University of Birmingham (2015).

caption_he:
שלוש דתות. אב אחד: אברהם.
בתורה לאברהם שני בנים. מיצחק יוצאים היהדות ואחריה הנצרות. המסורת האסלאמית מייחסת את הערבים לישמעאל.
610, מכה: לפי האמונה המוסלמית מוחמד מתחיל לקבל את הקוראן. 622: המעבר למדינה, שנה 1 בלוח המוסלמי. 632: מי ינהיג? רובם בחרו באבו בכר (סונים), חלק בעלי (שיעים).
638: ירושלים נכבשת. 691: כיפת הסלע. 1099: הצלבנים. 1187: צלאח א־דין.
היום: 2.3 מיליארד נוצרים, 2 מיליארד מוסלמים, 14.8 מיליון יהודים.
חלק 1 בפרופיל שלי. איזו עובדה הייתה חדשה לכם?
